jsesh.mdcDisplayer.secondaryData
Class MDCCaret

java.lang.Object
  jsesh.mdcDisplayer.secondaryData.MDCCaret
public class MDCCaret
extends java.lang.Object

The caret represent the editing position in a text. It takes in account both the insertion point where new signs will be inserted, and an optional mark. The space between the mark (if ant) and the insertion point is the selected area.

Note that both insert and mark can be null. IMPORTANT : we have just had a problem with a case where a text was changed, but not the caret. We could a) move the HieroglyphicTextModel class to the same package as caret, or maybe even to "model" and b) set up an observer system between the two. Another solution : if marks are immutable (in the sense that one can't move them except by changing the text), there is no need for mark listeners. Caret can still change, but in this case, we are in control. // TODO : use named marks, in order to avoid any memory leak problem.
